'''March 2000 Knoxville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Knoxville, TN on 5 March 2000. [[Jason Hasis]] won it. It is known from Jon Tomayko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d308">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-05-knoxville-tn-3-5-00-td-reportd308/ knoxville-tn-3-5-00-td-report], DeckTech (Jon "Bravo10" Tomayko, 5 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-05-knoxville-tn-3-5-00-td-reportd308/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 March 2000
* '''Site:''' Knoxville, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Hasis]]
